description.p: Gitpulsar is a modern, GNOME-native Git graphical client built with GTK4 and libadwaita. It provides an intuitive interface for managing Git repositories with features like commit browsing, staging, branching, stashing, and side-by-side diff viewing.

ul.li: Multi-repository workspace support with parallel scanning
Syntax-highlighted diffs with dark/light theme support
Undo/redo for staging operations and discards
Paginated commit history with async file loading
Branch management, tags, stashes with search
Remote operations (fetch, pull, push) via git CLI
Merge conflict detection and interactive rebase
Adaptive layout for mobile and desktop

description.p: Inline diff for commit files, colored status icons, slide animations, custom GNOME icons (branch, tag, git, commit), graph tab auto-refresh, minimum window size 800x500.
Blame view for per-line annotations, branch graph moved to integrated tab (Ctrl+3) with lazy background computation, fixed hang on repo switch.
3-way conflict resolution editor, line-level staging, conventional commit prefixes, keyboard navigation, theme-aware diff colors.

UI polish: submodules and worktrees panels in sidebar, merge/rebase conflict banner with continue/abort, interactive rebase editor, collapsible sidebar sections with item counts and configurable limit, auto-hide empty sections.

Major feature release: syntax-highlighted diffs, split staged/unstaged with drag-and-drop, partial hunk staging, undo/redo, paginated commits, parallel workspace scanning, merge/rebase support, submodules, worktrees, commit signing indicator, .gitignore editor, performance optimizations.
Auto set-upstream on push, layout and stability fixes.
Initial release with core Git functionality.
